NoAnimalBehind on YouTube is a place for everyone who loves animals and cares about their wellbeing. Our goals: 
1. Good Health
Every animal should be healthy, fit and whole.
2. A Happy Life
Every animal should have the space to thrive.
3. Natural Behaviours
Every animal should be able to express themselves.
4. Good Nutrition
Every animal should enjoy nutritious food and clean water
5. Positive mental experiences
Every animal deserves to enjoy life.
6. Expanding the circle of compassion to include all species
Every animal deserves protection and care and love!

If necessary, you can contact us via Email: daviddelima777@gmail.com


Thank you so much!
